unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The staged supplementary assets are local Nature article HTML landing pages. The XML/HTML point to 41598_2024_63552_MOESM1_ESM.pdf, but that true supplement PDF is not present in the local packet or landed supplementary directory; external fetching was outside the local-material contract.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: No structured supplementary table was available locally. Main XML/PDF supplied the curation-changing cytotoxicity, docking, and sequence/modification evidence used here.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Figure 11 is an image-only bar plot with error bars and no numeric source table. Exact per-bar viability values are not locally machine-readable; rows therefore use approximate figure-derived values and preserve exact DBAASP percentages as database-derived cautions.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Activity/toxicity evidence remains source-supported as approximate viability percentages and text-supported non-toxicity; exact database percentages are not promoted to exact primary-source values.

activity_summary: Worker-2 source review recovered 24 MTT cell-viability rows from primary Figure 11 for samples A and B across HaCaT, A431, and MDA-MB-231 at 10, 20, 50, and 100 µg/ml. Values are approximate figure estimates, with text confirming no toxic effect up to 100 µg/ml and HaCaT survival not below 80% after 72 h.
